title: game/damage.json
description: The causes of damage and the modifiers that apply to each (I05a, inventory-plan 3.6). Loaded by DamageData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); DamageValidator checks that every cause is one the code raises and has a row, and that every modifier id is registered in the code's DamageModifiers (today: armour), once per row.

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

causes.description: One row per cause the code raises.

modifiers.description: The ids of the modifiers that change this cause's damage, in the order they run (armour). Empty: the damage is taken as it is.
